translation: Took place in posad Serock, 3 June 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Moszek Mitelbach, carter, 25, and Moszek Cukier, also a carter, 34, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that on 1 June of this year at 4 PM died in posad Serock a child of female sex named Gitla Jagoda, aged six years, daughter of Moszek and Sura nee Grinberg, the Jagoda spouses residing in posad Serock. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and by them.
